Debug.Name: Enable Debug
Debug.Hint: Prints detailed step-by-step logs to the browser console for every minion damage event. Leave this off for normal play.

AutoSelect.Name: Preselect the proposed minions
AutoSelect.Hint: When on, the overkill dialog opens with the nearest minions already checked. When off, nothing is checked and the player picks the minions.

Diagnostics.Name: Run Diagnostics
Diagnostics.Label: Run Diagnostics
Diagnostics.Hint: Runs a self-test of the module's rules engine and lets you download a report to share when asking for help.

Groups.Name: Shared turns and bands
Groups.Hint: Groups the minions of the same stat block under one initiative and lets the GM split them into bands. Not compatible with Squad Combat Initiative: turn that module off first.

GroupMode.Name: Initiative of the groups
GroupMode.Hint: How the initiative of a group is decided. With "One roll per group" a single roll counts for the whole group: the captain's, in the bands that have one. With the other modes every member rolls and the group takes the average, the highest, the lowest or the median of the rolls (averages round up). Applies only when "Shared turns and bands" is on. Each band made with the "Groups and bands" window can have its own mode and captain.

Maximums.Name: Maximum band size
Maximums.Label: Edit the table
Maximums.Hint: The maximum number of creatures in a band for each challenge rating. The default is the table of the rules. Changing it affects game balance. Applies to the whole world.

Flag.Name: Minion
Flag.Hint: This actor is treated as a Minion by the Minion! module: reduced to 0 HP by the Minion trait, eligible for overkill.

Overkill.Title: Minion! - Overkill
Overkill.Intro: {attacker} hits {target} with {weapon} and deals enough damage to involve other minions.
Overkill.NoCandidates: No other minion in range: overkill only affects the target already hit.
Overkill.Limit: You can select at most {max} minion(s). Selected: {selected}.
Overkill.Locked: Opportunity attacks cause no overkill. Press Confirm to close.
Overkill.Shortfall: The excess damage would be enough for {count} more minion(s), but there are no others in range.

Chat.OneMore: {attacker} lands an overkill! Besides {target}, one more enemy falls.
Chat.ManyMore: {attacker} lands an overkill! Besides {target}, {count} more enemies fall.
Chat.NoOverkillConfirmed: {attacker} pressed Confirm but chose no minion: no overkill.
Chat.OverkillUndone: {attacker}'s overkill is undone: {count} minion(s) stand up again.

Notify.SceneNotViewed: Minion! overkill skipped: the GM is not viewing the scene where the attack happened.
Notify.OverkillFailed: Minion!: the overkill could not down {names}. See the console for details.
Notify.NoOverkillConfirmed: {attacker} pressed Confirm but chose no minion: no overkill.

Diagnostics.Title: Minion! - Diagnostics
Diagnostics.Failed: Engine self-test: {passed}/{total} passed, {failed} failed. Please attach the full report when asking for help.
Diagnostics.SaveHint: Click "Save Report" to download the full diagnostics file.

Groups.BlockedBySci: Minion!: “Shared turns and bands” is on, but Squad Combat Initiative is active and manages the same groups. Turn Squad Combat Initiative off in the module list. While it stays active, the Minion! groups remain off.

BandTurns.Failed: Minion!: the turn could not move through every member of the band. See the console for details.

GroupInitiative.Incomplete: Minion!: not every member of {group} has rolled initiative, so the group value was not calculated.
GroupInitiative.Failed: Minion!: could not complete the initiative of {group}. See the console for details.

Maximums.Title: Maximum band size
Maximums.Intro: Maximum creatures per band for each challenge rating. A creature above CR 21 uses the last row.
Maximums.Warning: Changing these values from the table of the rules affects game balance.
Maximums.ResetDone: Maximum table restored to the default.
Maximums.Invalid: Every maximum must be a whole number of at least 2. The table was not saved.
Maximums.Corrupt: Minion!: the stored maximum table is not valid, so the default table is being used. Open the table from the settings to fix it.

Bands.Title: Groups and bands
Bands.GroupsOff: Groups and bands needs "Shared turns and bands" to be on in the module settings.
Bands.NoCandidates: No minion available: the ones already in the combat and the ones without a challenge rating are not shown.
Bands.OpenFailed: Minion!: the groups and bands window could not be opened. See the console for details.

Question.Title: Selected tokens
Question.Content: Do you want to use only the selected monsters?
Question.No: No, all the ones in the scene

Bands.PlanNone: A single minion does not make a band: it will be added alone.

Error.Count: Band {band}: it needs {expected} members, it has {actual}.
Error.Name: Band {band}: the name cannot be empty.

Bands.FixErrors: Fix the errors to be able to apply.
Bands.Stale: Some creatures are no longer available: {names}. Close the window and open it again.
Bands.Applied: Bands applied: {groups} groups and {singles} creatures alone added to the combat.
Bands.ApplyFailed: Minion!: the bands could not be applied completely ({groups} groups and {combatants} combatants had already been created). See the console for details.

Confirm.Title: Apply the bands
Confirm.Content: You are about to add {count} types of monsters to the combat. Have you checked all the bands?

Bands.ExistingHeader: Bands already in the combat. The color can always be changed. The initiative mode and the captain can only be changed before the band rolls initiative.
Bands.ExistingLocked: This band has already rolled initiative: the mode and the captain can no longer be changed.
Bands.ExistingFailed: Minion!: the existing bands could not be updated. See the console for details.
